title: DECK on Sale!
speaker: Brad (ShadowTrader)

macro_themes.view: When AI is getting crushed, turn to non-tech stocks like consumer names at multi-year lows.

calls.condition: If DECK holds 77-78 on Monday and buyers come in, sell the Oct 30 77/78 put; if it gaps below the lows and stays, do nothing.
calls.reason: Post-earnings drop to multi-year support at 77-78, ~65% off the high, heading into the holidays.
calls.quote: I think Deckers uh presents a pretty decent opportunity at these levels given that we are coming into the holidays.

notes: Entry expressed as selling a short-dated put at 77/78 rather than buying shares; action mapped to 'buy'.
